A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] served as the main '''navigator''' aboard [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Darksaber (superweapon)|''Darksaber'']] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. He was killed when Durga accidentally executed him instead of the [[Unidentified Twi'lek security chief|Twi'lek security chief]].
